prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: reduced efficiency. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 40.6 °C (31% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 45.0 °C (25% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 47.2 °C (21% above healthy). Moderate fluid temperature rise and diminished heat exchange indicate degraded cooler efficiency.
Valve: severe lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.94 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.57 s (3% above healthy). Transient response is severely sluggish, preventing timely transition of working pressure.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.37 l/min (3% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 390 W·min/l (within 2% of healthy); SE system efficiency factor 56.2 % (4% below healthy). Motor draws full electrical power while circuit flow drops substantially, confirming internal fluid bypassing.
Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 46.5 bar (within 1% of healthy). Elevated pressure ripple across working lines indicates moderate degradation of accumulator pre-charge.
